description: Low-latency NDJSON envelope for passive Modbus/TCP sensor events. The observation fields are defined by modbus_observation/v1.

event_types.request_observed: Emitted as soon as a complete request ADU is decoded. response_status is pending.
event_types.transaction_observed: Emitted when a response is paired, an orphan response is observed, a request times out, a transaction ID is reused, or the input stream ends.

envelope_fields.name: sensor_run_id
envelope_fields.description: Changes on every process start; combine with event_sequence for run-local uniqueness.

envelope_fields.name: sensor_processing_usec
envelope_fields.description: Elapsed time from availability of the containing PCAP packet block through parsing and event construction, measured before NDJSON serialization.

hot_path.queueing: none; output applies synchronous bounded backpressure
